answer: An copycat running 176 aliases hence needs 174 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in wharf, expire in island, and cedar lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3234 identities would post 1020 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
